copy.qualified: Next is a short voice interview about your ownership experience, around 10 to 15 minutes. You'll need a microphone and a quiet spot. If you leave partway through, you can pick up where you stopped.
copy.screenedOut: This study is looking for a specific group of drivers, and your answers put you outside it. Your responses have been recorded, and there's nothing more to do.
copy.interviewHeading: A short conversation about your car.
copy.interviewBody: A moderator will ask {total} questions about your ownership experience — about 10 to 15 minutes. Find a quiet spot; you can pause and come back at any time without losing your place.

segments.label: Owner of a Mercedes-Benz or Audi

screening.prompt: What is your annual household income?
Do you currently own a car?
Which car brands do you currently own?

interview.text: Thank you for participating in our survey. I'm going to ask you {count} questions about your car ownership experience. This should take about 10-15 minutes. Are you ready to begin?

interview.topic: how long you've owned your vehicle
interview.text: How long have you owned your current vehicle?
What were the main factors that influenced your decision to purchase this specific brand?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how satisfied are you with your current vehicle?
What features or aspects of your car do you value most?

interview.topic: issues or concerns with your vehicle
interview.text: Have you experienced any issues or concerns with your vehicle?

interview.topic: why you chose BMW over other luxury brands
interview.text: What made you choose BMW over other luxury brands like Mercedes or Audi?

interview.topic: BMW's customer service and dealership experience
interview.text: How would you rate BMW's customer service and dealership experience?
Which BMW model do you own, and what do you love most about it?
How likely are you to purchase another BMW in the future? What would make you consider switching brands?
What could BMW improve to make your ownership experience even better?
Have you ever considered purchasing a BMW? Why or why not?

interview.topic: your impressions of the BMW brand
interview.text: What perceptions or impressions do you have of the BMW brand?

interview.topic: what it would take to switch to BMW
interview.text: What would it take for you to switch to BMW for your next vehicle purchase?

interview.topic: what your current brand does better
interview.text: Compared to BMW, what do you think your current brand does better?
If you were to recommend a luxury car brand to a friend, which would you choose and why?

interview.topic: anything else about your ownership experience
interview.text: Is there anything else you'd like to share about your vehicle ownership experience?
interview.anchor: anything else you'd like to share
